title: "GFAP and PY-STAT3 analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}

# ============================================================
# Packages
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(ggpubr)
library(officer)
library(rvg)

# ============================================================
# Load Fiji CSV
# ============================================================

csv_file <- "/Users/antina/Desktop/LPS/IF4/GFAP_PYSTAT3_fixed20_REAL.csv"
data <- read.csv(csv_file, check.names = FALSE)

# Fix empty column names
names(data)[is.na(names(data)) | names(data) == ""] <- paste0(
  "empty_col_",
  seq_len(sum(is.na(names(data)) | names(data) == ""))
)

# Remove completely empty columns
data <- data[, colSums(!is.na(data)) > 0]

# ============================================================
# Output folders
# ============================================================

dir.create("R_results", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("R_results/plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("R_results/stats", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# Metadata extraction
# Image format:
# IF4-A1-HP-a-1
# IF4 - animal - region - slice - Astro
# ============================================================

data_clean <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Image = as.character(Image),
    Image_clean = Image %>%
      str_remove("\\.tif$") %>%
      str_remove("\\.tiff$")
  ) %>%
  separate(
    Image_clean,
    into = c("Experiment", "Animal", "Region", "Slice", "Astro"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE,
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = case_when(
      Animal %in% c("A1", "A3", "A5") ~ "PBS",
      Animal %in% c("A2", "A4", "A6") ~ "LPS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("PBS", "LPS")),
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c("HP", "PFC", "ST")),
    Animal = factor(Animal),
    Astro = factor(Astro)
  )

# ============================================================
# Long format
# ============================================================

long_data <- data_clean %>%
  transmute(
    Image,
    Animal,
    Region,
    Slice,
    Astro,
    Condition,

    GFAP_area = GFAP_pixel_count_ge_20,
    GFAP_raw_intensity = GFAP_mean_all_pixels,
    GFAP_thresholded_intensity = GFAP_mean_pixels_ge_20,
    GFAP_intden = GFAP_intden_pixels_ge_20,

    PY_STAT3_area = PY_STAT3_pixel_count_ge_20,
    PY_STAT3_raw_intensity = PY_STAT3_mean_all_pixels,
    PY_STAT3_thresholded_intensity = PY_STAT3_mean_pixels_ge_20,
    PY_STAT3_intden = PY_STAT3_intden_pixels_ge_20
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      GFAP_area,
      GFAP_raw_intensity,
      GFAP_thresholded_intensity,
      GFAP_intden,
      PY_STAT3_area,
      PY_STAT3_raw_intensity,
      PY_STAT3_thresholded_intensity,
      PY_STAT3_intden
    ),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Marker = case_when(
      str_detect(Measure, "^GFAP") ~ "GFAP",
      str_detect(Measure, "^PY_STAT3") ~ "PY-STAT3"
    ),
    Metric = case_when(
      str_detect(Measure, "area") ~ "Area",
      str_detect(Measure, "raw_intensity") ~ "Raw intensity",
      str_detect(Measure, "thresholded_intensity") ~ "Thresholded intensity",
      str_detect(Measure, "intden") ~ "Integrated density"
    ),
    Marker = factor(Marker, levels = c("GFAP", "PY-STAT3")),
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "Area",
        "Raw intensity",
        "Thresholded intensity",
        "Integrated density"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Value),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(Region),
    !is.na(Animal)
  )

write.csv(
  long_data,
  "R_results/clean_long_data_GFAP_PYSTAT3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Colours
# PBS = blue, LPS = red
# Individual mice = shades of blue/red
# ============================================================

cond_colors <- c(
  "PBS" = "#2E6CE6",
  "LPS" = "#D62728"
)

mouse_colors <- c(
  "A1" = "#9EC5FF",
  "A3" = "#4F8CFF",
  "A5" = "#003F9E",
  "A2" = "#FFB0B0",
  "A4" = "#E53935",
  "A6" = "#8B0000"
)

# ============================================================
# Statistics helpers
# ============================================================

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "ns",
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

run_stats_region <- function(df) {

  model <- lmer(value ~ condition + (1 | mouse/Astro), data = df)

  tukey <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ condition, adjust = "tukey")
  tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey$contrasts)

  pval <- tukey_df$p.value[1]

  list(
    model = model,
    anova = anova(model),
    tukey = tukey,
    shapiro = shapiro.test(residuals(model)),
    levene = car::leveneTest(value ~ condition, data = df),
    p.value = pval,
    p_label = p_to_stars(pval)
  )
}

make_condition_annotations <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    group_modify(~ {

      if (n_distinct(.x$condition) < 2) return(tibble())

      stats <- run_stats_region(.x)

      ymax <- max(.x$value, na.rm = TRUE)
      ymin <- min(.x$value, na.rm = TRUE)
      yrange <- ymax - ymin

      if (yrange == 0) yrange <- ymax * 0.1
      if (yrange == 0) yrange <- 1

      tibble(
        group1 = "PBS",
        group2 = "LPS",
        y.position = ymax + 0.15 * yrange,
        p = stats$p.value,
        p_label = stats$p_label
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# ============================================================
# Plot function
# Design matched to previous analysis:
# open violins, square mouse points, mean point, mean ± SE,
# mouse legend, region facets, stars on plot.
# ============================================================

plot_violin_condition <- function(df, title_text, ylab_text, ann_df, show_mouse_legend = TRUE) {

  ggplot(df, aes(x = condition, y = value)) +

    geom_violin(
      aes(color = condition),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(color = mouse),
      shape = 15,
      size = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.12,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      ann_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +

    facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "free_y") +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(cond_colors, mouse_colors),
      breaks = names(mouse_colors)
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    theme(
      legend.position = ifelse(show_mouse_legend, "right", "none"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_blank()
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab_text,
      color = "Mouse ID"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# Run analysis and create editable PowerPoint
# ============================================================

ppt <- read_pptx()

for (marker_name in levels(long_data$Marker)) {

  for (metric_name in levels(long_data$Metric)) {

    df_plot <- long_data %>%
      filter(Marker == marker_name, Metric == metric_name) %>%
      rename(
        mouse = Animal,
        region = Region,
        condition = Condition,
        value = Value
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        condition = factor(condition, levels = c("PBS", "LPS")),
        region = factor(region, levels = c("HP", "PFC", "ST")),
        mouse = factor(mouse, levels = c("A1", "A3", "A5", "A2", "A4", "A6"))
      )

    cat("\n\n##", marker_name, "-", metric_name, "\n\n")

    ann_df <- make_condition_annotations(df_plot)

    p <- plot_violin_condition(
      df = df_plot,
      title_text = paste(marker_name, "-", metric_name),
      ylab_text = metric_name,
      ann_df = ann_df,
      show_mouse_legend = TRUE
    )

    print(p)

    clean_name <- paste(marker_name, metric_name, sep = "_") %>%
      str_replace_all(" ", "_") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "_")

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("R_results/plots/", clean_name, ".pdf"),
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = 6
    )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("R_results/plots/", clean_name, ".png"),
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = 6,
      dpi = 300
    )

    ppt <- add_slide(ppt, layout = "Blank", master = "Office Theme")
    ppt <- ph_with(
      ppt,
      dml(ggobj = p),
      location = ph_location_fullsize()
    )

    for (region_name in levels(df_plot$region)) {

      df_region <- df_plot %>%
        filter(region == region_name)

      if (nrow(df_region) == 0) next
      if (n_distinct(df_region$condition) < 2) next

      stats <- run_stats_region(df_region)

      cat("\n\n### Region:", region_name, "\n\n")
      cat("Model: `value ~ condition + (1 | mouse/Astro)`\n\n")

      cat("\n#### Linear mixed model\n\n")
      print(summary(stats$model))

      cat("\n#### ANOVA\n\n")
      print(stats$anova)

      cat("\n#### Tukey post hoc\n\n")
      print(stats$tukey)

      cat("\n#### Shapiro test on residuals\n\n")
      print(stats$shapiro)

      cat("\n#### Levene test\n\n")
      print(stats$levene)

      stat_name <- paste(marker_name, metric_name, region_name, sep = "_") %>%
        str_replace_all(" ", "_") %>%
        str_replace_all("-", "_")

      sink(paste0("R_results/stats/", stat_name, "_stats.txt"))

      cat("Marker:", marker_name, "\n")
      cat("Metric:", metric_name, "\n")
      cat("Region:", region_name, "\n")
      cat("Model: value ~ condition + (1 | mouse/Astro)\n\n")

      cat("Linear mixed model\n")
      print(summary(stats$model))

      cat("\nANOVA\n")
      print(stats$anova)

      cat("\nTukey post hoc\n")
      print(stats$tukey)

      cat("\nShapiro test on residuals\n")
      print(stats$shapiro)

      cat("\nLevene test\n")
      print(stats$levene)

      sink()
    }
  }
}
# ============================================================
# Extra plots:
# PY-STAT3 raw + thresholded intensity
# All regions pooled together: PBS vs LPS
# ============================================================

for (metric_name in c("Raw intensity", "Thresholded intensity")) {
  
  df_pooled <- long_data %>%
    filter(
      Marker == "PY-STAT3",
      Metric == metric_name
    ) %>%
    rename(
      mouse = Animal,
      condition = Condition,
      value = Value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("PBS", "LPS")),
      mouse = factor(mouse, levels = c("A1", "A3", "A5", "A2", "A4", "A6"))
    )
  
  model <- lmer(value ~ condition + (1 | mouse), data = df_pooled)
  tukey <- emmeans(model, pairwise ~ condition, adjust = "tukey")
  tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey$contrasts)
  pval <- tukey_df$p.value[1]
  
  ymax <- max(df_pooled$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ymin <- min(df_pooled$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  if (yrange == 0) yrange <- 1
  
  ann_df <- tibble(
    group1 = "PBS",
    group2 = "LPS",
    y.position = ymax + 0.15 * yrange,
    p_label = p_to_stars(pval)
  )
  
  p_pooled <- ggplot(df_pooled, aes(x = condition, y = value)) +
    geom_violin(
      aes(color = condition),
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      trim = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = mouse),
      shape = 15,
      size = 1.1,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.12,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      ann_df,
      label = "p_label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(cond_colors, mouse_colors),
      breaks = names(mouse_colors)
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("PY-STAT3 -", metric_name, "- all regions pooled"),
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_name,
      color = "Mouse ID"
    )
  
  print(p_pooled)
  
  clean_name <- paste0(
    "PY_STAT3_",
    str_replace_all(metric_name, " ", "_"),
    "_all_regions_pooled"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("R_results/plots/", clean_name, ".pdf"),
    plot = p_pooled,
    width = 6,
    height = 6
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("R_results/plots/", clean_name, ".png"),
    plot = p_pooled,
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ppt <- add_slide(ppt, layout = "Blank", master = "Office Theme")
  ppt <- ph_with(
    ppt,
    dml(ggobj = p_pooled),
    location = ph_location_fullsize()
  )
  
  sink(paste0("R_results/stats/", clean_name, "_stats.txt"))
  cat("PY-STAT3", metric_name, "all regions pooled\n")
  cat("Model: value ~ condition + (1 | mouse)\n\n")
  print(summary(model))
  print(anova(model))
  print(tukey)
  print(shapiro.test(residuals(model)))
  print(car::leveneTest(value ~ condition, data = df_pooled))
  sink()
}

print(ppt, target = "R_results/GFAP_PYSTAT3_editable_plots.pptx")

cat("\n\nEditable PowerPoint saved as: `R_results/GFAP_PYSTAT3_editable_plots.pptx`\n\n")
cat("\n\nAll plots saved in: `R_results/plots/`\n\n")
cat("\n\nAll stats saved in: `R_results/stats/`\n\n")
```
